subject: SIG: Encryption controls — key rotation evidence and delivery
messages:
From: Paul Tan <paul.tan@acme-corp.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 19 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — encryption: rotation cadence, HSM attestation

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for taking the SIG. A couple of follow-ups from our InfoSec reviewer that cut specifically to encryption controls:

1) Key rotation cadence — they want evidence of rotation events for the past 12 months (audit entries, who performed the rotation, and rationale).
2) HSM custody / vendor attestation — a certificate or attestation from the HSM vendor showing FIPS 140-2/3 or equivalent and that keys are generated inside the HSM.
3) Envelope/CEK handling — confirmation that customer data keys (CEKs) are rotated independently of master keys and whether you support customer-managed keys (CMK).

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and a tentative delivery timeline? If we can get a matrix + cert chain that would help us close this section.

Best,
Paul
Paul Tan
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

P.S. our deadline for the SIG packet is Jan 31 — any chance we can get materials by Jan 25?

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Tan <paul.tan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — encryption: rotation cadence, HSM attestation

Paul — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Rishi (Crypto Ops) and Evelyn (Compliance) to coordinate artifacts. Summary / plan below: 

- Rotation evidence: we can produce a rotation matrix (spreadsheet) showing rotation events for the last 12 months, including timestamp, operator (automation/role), key id, reason (scheduled/incident), and link to audit log entries.
- HSM attestation: we will include the HSM vendor attestation and cert chain (PEM).
- Envelope keys: confirm that CEKs are enveloped with KMS-managed root keys; CEKs are rewritten during major key-rotation events — will document exact cadence and procedure in the matrix.
- CMK support: we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments (bring-your-own-KMS/HSM). For Hosted customers we offer envelope encryption with our KMS; we will explicitly call out which deployments support CMK in the deliverable.

Can you confirm you need raw audit log extracts (redacted) or the summarized rotation matrix + links to logs is sufficient? We intend to deliver (a) redwood_key_rotation_matrix_2028-01.xlsx, (b) hsm_cert_chain_2028-01.pem, and (c) a short PDF narrative for SIG answers. Delivery target: Jan 25 EOD PST. If that works, we'll proceed.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stub: redwood_key_rotation_matrix_draft.xlsx (will attach final in follow-up)

From: Paul Tan <paul.tan@acme-corp.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jan 2028 11:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — encryption: rotation cadence, HSM attestation

Thanks, Olga — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications from our reviewer: 

- For rotation audit evidence we do need the raw audit entries (redacted usernames ok) for a representative sample of rotations (they asked for 3 events spanning different operators).
- For the HSM attestation, please include the vendor statement and the certificate chain; if you can also point us to the FIPS report or vendor URL that would be great.
- On CMK: specifically call out whether Hosted API customers can opt into CMK at present or if that's only for Private deployments.

If you can hit Jan 25 with the files you mentioned plus 3 redacted audit log extracts, we'll be able to attach them to the SIG packet and close the encryption section. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Paul

Paul — attaching the deliverables for the SIG encryption section. Summary of attachments and what each contains: 

1) redwood_key_rotation_matrix_2028-01.xlsx — rotation events table (last 12 months), change type, operator (redacted where requested), ticket/PR links, and direct links to audit log entries in our internal log archive.
2) hsm_cert_chain_2028-01.pem — HSM vendor cert chain and vendor attestation (PEM + statement).
3) sig_encryption_answers_2028-01.pdf — short narrative answering the SIG sub-questions (in-transit, at-rest, KMS architecture, CMK support, incident-handling and rotation procedure).

Quick notes: 
- We included three redacted rotation log extracts (samples) inline in the rotation matrix (rows flagged). If you'd prefer separate raw log files, we can export them to a secure SharePoint link.
- Hosted API: CMK is not generally available for Hosted customers at this time; CMK is supported in Redwood Private and Dedicated via customer-managed HSM/KMS integrations. We call this out explicitly in the PDF.
- All key generation is performed inside an HSM (vendor name and cert chain provided). Root keys are rotated annually by scheduled job; intermediate/envelope keys are rotated on a quarterly cadence or on-demand for incidents. The matrix shows the last rotations and the automation runbook entry.

Next steps: if the packet looks complete, can you confirm receipt for the SIG and any follow-on requests? We can schedule a 30-min walkthrough if review comments come back.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
